notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
description:
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{U}, putting an ice counter on Soldevi Adnate and causing it to become snow.
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Narfi, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Narfi dies, Soldevi Adnate triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Narfi by paying {S}{S}{S}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
